findings.defect: The established term 사천혈사 is rendered with the wrong English title.
findings.rationale: The glossary binds 사천혈사 to “Sichuan Blood Tragedy,” and the accepted baseline preserves that term.

findings.current: I was already in the middle of researching it… What’s wrong, Jin?
findings.defect: The causal detail that Johnson was researching the magic circle because of this discovery has been dropped.
findings.rationale: 이것 때문에 explicitly establishes the reason for the research; the current wording only states that research was underway.
findings.replacement: I was already in the middle of researching it because of this… What’s wrong, Jin?

findings.current: What the hell is going on?
findings.defect: The line loses the source’s explicit characterization of the situation as vile or shitty, changing an exasperated judgment into a more general question.
findings.rationale: 개 같은 상황 is not merely confusion about what is happening; it labels the situation itself as awful. The accepted baseline preserves that distinction.
findings.replacement: What the hell kind of situation is this?

findings.current: We left the head of security and his guards behind after they snapped off razor-sharp salutes.
findings.defect: The physical detail describing the angle of the salutes has been replaced with a description of crispness or sharp execution.
findings.rationale: 칼 같은 각도로 specifies the angle at which the salutes were raised, not that the salutes were performed sharply.
findings.replacement: We left the head of security and his guards behind after they gave us salutes at knife-sharp angles.

findings.current: The same work was probably underway in every city caught up in the war.
findings.defect: “Every city” adds a universal quantifier not established by the source.
findings.rationale: 도시 곳곳에서 indicates various places throughout the affected cities, not necessarily every city involved in the war.
findings.replacement: The same work was probably underway throughout the cities caught up in the war.

findings.current: a club nearby with a great crowd
findings.defect: The euphemistic implication that the club has attractive female patrons is lost, weakening the setup for the later gay-bar joke.
findings.rationale: 물 좋은 클럽 in this context refers to a venue with attractive women. That meaning explains why the Skeleton King is interested and why Jin considers telling him it is a gay bar.
findings.replacement: a club nearby with plenty of attractive women

summary: The chapter is broadly faithful, but several localized changes weaken established terminology, causal detail, source-specific imagery, or joke logic.
